question: Should colors and typography visible inside document artwork, Imagine onboarding and Premium marketing visuals be promoted into global product UI tokens?
candidate_options: Promote the visible colors/type direction globally
Keep document and marketing visuals scoped; define neutral product-shell tokens independently
recommended_default: Keep document and marketing visuals scoped; define neutral product-shell tokens independently
